claim: An IP address you assign to an instance must be part of the subnet's IP address range, must not be reserved by Amazon for IP networking purposes, and must not be currently assigned to another interface.

values.display: Part of the associated subnet's IP address range
Not reserved by Amazon for IP networking purposes
values.spoken: not one of the reserved addresses

values.display: Not currently assigned to another interface
values.spoken: not already used by another interface

evidence.quote: You can assign any IP address to your instance as long as it is:
Part of the associated subnet's IP address range
Not reserved by Amazon for IP networking purposes
Not currently assigned to another interface
evidence.heading: Can I assign any IP address to an instance?
